title: Islamabad Captial Territory Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Islamabad Captial Territory Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY
ISLAMABAD CAPITAL
TERRITORY
LOCAL GOVERNMENT
ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CII OF 2002
(An Ordinance to
amend the Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Elections Ordinance,
2002)
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary Part-I, 28th October, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
28-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title, extent and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Islamabad Capital
Territory Local Government Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 2nd October, 2002.

Amendment of section 15, Ordinance LVII of 2002

ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY
ISLAMABAD CAPITAL
TERRITORY
LOCAL GOVERNMENT
ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CII OF 2002
(An Ordinance to
amend the Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Elections Ordinance,
2002)
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary Part-I, 28th October, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
28-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 15,
Ordinance LVII of 2002.---In the Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government
Elections Ordinance, 2002 (LVII of 2002), hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance; in section 15, for clause (e) the following shall be substituted,
namely:
"(e) is at
least a graduate possessing a bachelor degree in any discipline or any degree
recognized as equivalent under any law for the time being in force, for
contesting election of a Nazim or Naib Nazim;"
